title: Welcome to Cairn
intro: A few steps to get this server ready. You can change all of it later.

security.title: Protect your account with two-step verification
security.why: Your password alone protects this whole server. With two-step verification, signing in also needs a code from an app on your phone, so a stolen or guessed password is not enough.
security.how: You need an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or any other app for one-time codes.
security.on: Two-step verification is on for your account.

software.intro: Choose what to install now, one version of each. Everything can also be installed later from the Software page.

preset.title: Presets
preset.intro: Starting points: a preset adds its software to your selection in the recommended version. You can then change or remove each one.

selection.title: Your selection
selection.empty: Nothing selected yet. Add a preset or pick software below.
selection.full: One installation takes at most {max} software. Remove one to add another; the rest can be installed later.
selection.notAllAdded: {count} item did not fit: one installation takes at most {max} software. | {count} items did not fit: one installation takes at most {max} software.

catalog.title: Add software
catalog.empty: No software can be installed on this system.

php-site.name: PHP site
php-site.description: For PHP sites such as WordPress: a web server, PHP, a database and a cache.

node-java.name: Node/Java projects
node-java.description: For Node.js and Java projects: a web server and both runtimes.

confirm.title: Check and start
confirm.endOfLife: Upstream support for {name} {line} ended on {date}: it no longer gets security fixes. It is installed because you chose it.
confirm.endOfLifeUndated: Upstream support for {name} {line} has ended: it no longer gets security fixes. It is installed because you chose it.

start.title: Installation started
start.background: The installation continues in the background. You can go to the overview or other settings meanwhile; the task center shows the full output.
